forbidden.comment: A slice owns its request, handler, validation and data access; one that imports another slice cannot be changed or deleted on its own. plan:rulebearing-vertical-slices
forbidden.fix: Move what both slices need into the shared kernel, or have one slice publish an event or call the other through its public request rather than its internals.
forbidden.name: slices-are-independent

forbidden.comment: The shared kernel is what every slice may use; one that imports a slice makes every slice depend on it. plan:rulebearing-vertical-slices
forbidden.fix: Move the code the shared kernel needs out of the slice into the shared kernel, or invert the dependency behind an interface the slice implements.
forbidden.name: slices-shared-kernel-not-to-slices
